description: This is a unit test class for the Meetings module in SuiteCRM, testing various functionalities such as object initialization, ACL permissions, notifications, relationship handling, and data retrieval.

classes.name: MeetingTest
classes.description: Unit test class for the Meetings module in SuiteCRM, extends the SuitePHPUnitFrameworkTestCase for testing.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Prepares the test environment, initializes current user and configuration.

methods.name: testMeeting
methods.description: Tests the instantiation and initial property values of a Meeting bean.

methods.name: testACLAccess
methods.description: Verifies ACL permissions for Meeting records with and without recurring_source.

methods.name: testhasIntegratedMeeting
methods.description: Checks the presence of an integrated meeting within Meeting bean.

methods.name: testSaveAndMarkdeletedAndSetAcceptStatus
methods.description: Tests saving a Meeting record, setting accept status, and deletion functionalities.

methods.name: testget_summary_text
methods.description: Verifies retrieval of meeting summary text.

methods.name: testfill_in_additional_detail_fields
methods.description: Tests filling in additional details for a Meeting bean.

methods.name: testget_list_view_data
methods.description: Validates the data prepared for list view display of a Meeting.

methods.name: testset_notification_body
methods.description: Checks the notification email body population based on meeting attributes.

methods.name: testcreate_notification_email
methods.description: Verifies creation of notification email objects for Meeting.

methods.name: testsend_assignment_notifications
methods.description: Tests sending assignment notifications email for Meeting.

methods.name: testget_meeting_users
methods.description: Verifies retrieval of meeting users.

methods.name: testget_invite_meetings
methods.description: Checks retrieval of invite meetings for a user.

methods.name: testget_notification_recipients
methods.description: Verifies notification recipient logic with and without special notification setting.

methods.name: testbean_implements
methods.description: Tests the bean_implements method for various capabilities.

methods.description: Verifies default status for a new Meeting.

methods.name: testgetMeetingsExternalApiDropDown
methods.description: Tests retrieval of external API dropdown options.

methods.description: Verifies the generation of meeting type options from dictionaries and lists.
